answer: Provenance ledger (irreversible compute spend). Each agent identity must publish a signed mirror of its full model-inference and tool-call trace, hashed per step. A fixed horizon of 90 days of verified compute history is required before an identity can transact, and every trace is cross-checked against hardware attestation. Attackers cannot buy history: they must actually run 90 days of sustained inference, paying real GPU-time and energy per identity. Forging traces fails attestation; cloning collapses on divergent hashes. The oasis for honest agents is cheap continuity;
